title: Annotation API v2 image embedding request
description: JSON body of POST /api/v2/embeddings/image/. The endpoint also accepts a multipart form: the image in a `file` field, and `model`, `normalize` and `id` as form fields.

model.description: Embedding model. `openclip` and `siglip2` embed images in the same space as their text embeddings.

normalize.description: Return the L2-normalised embedding (true) or the raw model output (false).
